environment.build_info: version=2.0.1 jpeg=libjpeg-turbo png=libpng webp=libwebp zlib=zlib-ng threads=on simd=neon mock=off
environment.effort: at least 5 runs and 1 s per case, after one run to warm up

blocks.title: 1. What a call costs: C, cffi and the binding

tables.title: Loading a file
tables.about: A JPEG file into a context that is kept from load to load.

tables.title: Loading encoded bytes
tables.about: The same JPEG already in memory, in the forms a program holds it.

tables.title: Loading decoded pixels
tables.about: The same image decoded (by Pillow, untimed) into 8-bit RGB pixels, in the forms numpy, OpenCV and Pillow hand them over.

tables.title: One hash of a loaded image, 400×400
tables.about: Each hash computed again on an image that a first hash prepared: the grayscale image and the area grid are cached in the context, so the 64-bit hashes cost little more than the call itself.

tables.title: Loading and one hash, 400×400
tables.about: A load of the encoded bytes and the first hash on it, which prepares the grayscale image and the area grid: what one image and one hash cost.

tables.title: One hash of a loaded image, 20 Mpx
tables.about: Each hash computed again on an image that a first hash prepared: the grayscale image and the area grid are cached in the context, so the 64-bit hashes cost little more than the call itself.

tables.title: Loading and one hash, 20 Mpx
tables.about: A load of the encoded bytes and the first hash on it, which prepares the grayscale image and the area grid: what one image and one hash cost.

tables.title: Several hashes of one load
tables.about: A load of the encoded bytes and the four 64-bit hashes (or all nine). hashes() computes the 64-bit ones in one ph_compute_multi() call, which shares their work on the full image.

tables.title: From a file to its pHash
tables.about: Per image: a new context for each, one context kept, or a batch on one thread (threads=1, the calling thread) of 64 copies of the file.

tables.title: Comparing two hashes
tables.about: One comparison of two hashes of two similar photographs (photo.jpeg and photo_copy.jpeg), and the conversions of a hash.

blocks.title: 4. Parallelism

tables.title: Throughput against workers, 400×400
tables.about: Images per second for 1000 loads of the file and their pHash, and the speedup over one worker. A process pool is started before it is timed (the next table has that cost) and keeps one context per process.

tables.title: Throughput against workers, 20 Mpx
tables.about: Images per second for 22 loads of the file and their pHash, and the speedup over one worker. A process pool is started before it is timed (the next table has that cost) and keeps one context per process.

tables.title: Starting a process pool
tables.about: A ProcessPoolExecutor of 11 processes, each importing libphash and creating its context, until every one has answered; then shut down.

tables.title: An asyncio loop while hashing, 20 Mpx
tables.about: How late a task that sleeps 1 ms again and again wakes up while 8 images are hashed: the loop's lag. With the GIL released in C, work handed to a thread leaves the loop responsive.

tables.title: The batch's progress callback, 400×400
tables.about: hash_files() of 1000 copies of the file, per image: without a callback and with a progress callback that does nothing. The callback takes the GIL on a worker thread of C for every image.

notes: Subinterpreters: `import libphash` in an interpreter of `concurrent.interpreters.create()` gives `ImportError: module _native does not support loading in subinterpreters`.

tables.title: import libphash
tables.about: A fresh interpreter that imports libphash, against one that imports nothing; -X importtime's cumulative time of the package.

tables.title: Size
tables.about: The extension module (libphash and its decoders, linked statically) and, when given, the wheel.
